settings.brands_heading: Bring your brand closer to the U.S. consumer.
settings.brands_body:
Seoul Glow Lab partners selectively with Korean beauty brands we genuinely believe in.

Through retail placement at SGL, product education, launches, founder-led events, content, and real-world customer feedback, we give brands opportunities to be experienced and understood, not simply put on a shelf.

We're especially interested in emerging and indie brands bringing something genuinely interesting to Korean beauty.
settings.retailers_heading: Discover indie Korean beauty for your business.
settings.retailers_body:
Seoul Glow Lab works B2B with select indie Korean beauty brands we genuinely believe in, helping connect their products with retailers, estheticians, med spas, and other beauty businesses in the U.S.

Through our relationships with brands in Korea and firsthand knowledge of their products, we give industry partners access to emerging Korean skincare and help facilitate B2B opportunities that make sense for their business.
